svg.title: Deploy $12,000–$60,000 Without Buying the Whole Asset
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-four-buckets; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Deploy $12,000–$60,000 Without Buying the Whole Asset; subtitle: Four startup buckets shown at a $36,000 planning allocation; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values show the $36,000 planning allocation. Matched lean allocations total $12,000; matched expanded allocations total $60,000. These budgets fund diligence, conditional control, and runway, not full easement purchases or major yard construction. Capital deployment is not automatically a current-period operating expense.; caption: The lean budget depends on low deposits, staged reports, and limited cash burn. First-deal timing is 2–6 months and monthly operating expense planning is $2,000–$12,000; the startup range does not cover every timing and burn combination.; stages: label: Rights and transaction setup; value: $8,000 planning allocation; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Lean $3,000; expanded $12,000. Fund entity-specific contracts, title review, licensing analysis, consent planning, and documented control instruments before committing to acquisition obligations.; label: Site and permit investigation; value: $10,000 planning allocation; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Lean $3,000; expanded $16,000. Stage Phase I work, surveys, drainage review, sign eligibility checks, and heavy-vehicle use verification by parcel priority.; label: Conditional control and deposits; value: $12,000 planning allocation; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Lean $4,000; expanded $22,000. Reserve cash for negotiated options, refundable deposits where available, and initial yard security deposits; track refund conditions and expiry dates separately.; label: Systems and working reserve; value: $6,000 planning allocation; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Lean $2,000; expanded $10,000. Fund GIS hosting, document storage, billing setup, insurance activation, and operating liquidity. Stress-test slower closings before treating this reserve as sufficient runway.
